testsuite.name: com.chimali.core.database.EncryptedDriverFactoryTest

testcase.name: createDriver preserves database and sidecars and erases root copy on open failure(File)
createDriver throws IllegalStateException when master seed is null()
verifyIntegrity returns false when database file does not exist()
deriveDatabaseKey derives deterministic 256-bit key from seed()
createDriver initializes a clean database and reopens it normally(File)
verifyIntegrity fails closed when an existing database cannot be opened()
createDriver erases its owned root copy after driver creation fails()
